about_short_description.short_description: Newton Research has developed a team of AI agents extensively trained on marketing analytics.

product.name: AI-Powered Marketing Analytics Agents
product.description: A suite of AI agents trained to automate marketing analytics workflows, including data preparation, modeling, reporting, and insight generation.

product.name: Customer 360 Analytics
product.description: Tools to analyze and model customer behavior across channels to predict churn and optimize lifetime value and satisfaction.

product.name: Planning and Activation Analytics
product.description: Analytics for optimizing cross-channel media plans, budget allocation, audience targeting, and campaign forecasting.

product.name: Measurement and Incrementality Analysis
product.description: Advanced measurement tools for evaluating marketing effectiveness, including test design and incremental lift analysis.

product.name: Reporting and Insight Generation
product.description: Automated creation of custom reports and dashboards to deliver marketing insights and support decision-making.

identifier.value: Anomaly Detection and Data Quality Assurance

product.name: Anomaly Detection and Data Quality Assurance
product.description: Tools to detect anomalies and outliers in marketing data to identify errors and prevent issues.
